name: Guangdong TCL Smart Home Appliances Co., Ltd.
summary: Guangdong TCL Smart Home Appliances Co., Ltd. engages in the research, development, manufacture, and sales of household refrigerators, freezers, and washing machines in China and internationally. The company also exports its products. The company was formerly known as Guangdong Homa Group Co., Ltd. and changed its name to Guangdong TCL Smart Home Appliances Co., Ltd. in May 2024. The company was founded in 2002 and is based in Zhongshan, China.
